positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer
positions.description:
- Designed and led full-stack development of a company-wide work order management platform serving several hundred daily users, independently designing the system architecture and database while partnering with executive and senior engineering leadership on workflow and company-specific requirements.

- Diagnosed and resolved several core workflow bottlenecks on the internal platform, cutting task completion time for end users by up to 3–4x in many instances.

- Consolidated 6 separate departmental workflows into a single centralized platform, reducing cross-departmental handoff time by 30% and eliminating redundant manual processes.

- Contributed to automating application deployments to internal VM environments using Ansible AWX, ensuring consistent production releases and reducing manual deployment effort.

- Built RESTful APIs integrating operational and financial data to ensure consistent, reliable downstream processing and billing accuracy.

- Developed backend services in TypeScript and PostgreSQL with a strong emphasis on data integrity, validation, and transactional reliability.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Engineered Spring Boot services and REST APIs designed to support core e-commerce order and transaction workflows.

- Built Angular and TypeScript features for a large-scale digital commerce platform, focused on improving usability and performance.

- Developed automated end-to-end test suites using Java, JUnit, and Selenium to support release stability and reduce regression risk.

- Contributed to sprint planning, peer code reviews, and iterative feature delivery within a distributed Agile team of 50+ engineers.
positions.insights: Skills: AngularJS · TypeScript · MySQL · Java · HTML · Bootstrap · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Spring Framework · Spring Boot · Postman API

positions.title: IT Networking Assistant
positions.description:
- Delivered cross-platform technical support to students and faculty across Windows, macOS, and Linux environments, resolving hardware, software, and network connectivity issues.

- Configured and reprovisioned Aruba wireless access points using cloud management tools and command-line interfaces to maintain reliable campus Wi-Fi infrastructure.

- Leveraged Bash and PowerShell to diagnose system configuration issues and support network operations in a high-volume environment.

positions.title: Technician Assistant
positions.description:

- Assisted professors with setting up computers as well as other technological issues.

- Reimaged computers.
